name: PCMFlowBluetooth
description: Bluetooth Classic audio add-on for PCMFlow. Connects the encoded audio payloads handled by EspBle to PCMFlow's PCMSource / PCMSink boundary. Owns the codec, the packet queue and the PCM boundary only; Bluetooth profiles stay in EspBle and device output stays in PCMFlow / PCMFlowDevice. The initial release decodes A2DP Sink SBC into interleaved signed 16-bit PCM on the plain ESP32.
keywords: audio, pcm, bluetooth, a2dp, sbc, codec, esp32
